scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && ([ "$SEED_DEMO" = "1" ] && tsx prisma/seed.ts || true) && next build
scripts.sqlite:prepare: node scripts/make-sqlite-schema.mjs && DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && node -e "for (const f of ['prisma/dev.db','prisma/dev.db-journal']) require('fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma --skip-generate
scripts.dev:sqlite: npm run sqlite:prepare && DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db tsx prisma/seed.ts && DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db next dev
